About Ribbon Ribbon Communications (Nasdaq: RBBN ) delivers, AIOps and automation , secure cloud communications and IP and optical networking solutions to service providers, enterprises, mission-critical defense, and critical infrastructure sectors globally. We engage deeply with our customers, helping them modernize their networks for improved competitive positioning and business outcomes in today's smart, always-on, and data-hungry world. Our end-to-end portfolio of communications software, IP routing, and optical networking solutions delivers superior value and innovation by leveraging cloud-native architectures, automation and analytics tools, and leading-edge security. We maintain a keen focus on our commitments to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) matters, offering an annual Sustainability Report to our stakeholders.
Intelligent IP Optical Solutions Portfolio Brochure

Ribbon has customers in virtually every region of the world, including North America, Central and Latin America, Asia Pacific, Europe, and the Middle East. Some of Ribbon's customers include leading service providers such as Verizon, Bharti Airtel, Rogers, MTN, BT, Deutsche Telekom, Softbank, Optimum, and Tata, as well as large enterprises such as Liberty Mutual Insurance and Texas A&M, along with critical infrastructure providers such as American Electric Power and the US Department of Defense.
Ribbon takes products to market via service providers, channel partners, and Independent Software Vendors (ISVs).
Ribbon also boasts a world-class ecosystem of technology partners, including global brands like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, IBM and Intel.

The Ribbon name reflects the company's mission to deliver an unparalleled suite of best-in-class solutions and services to its growing list of global customers and partners. Ribbon Communications embodies the company's ambition to continue moving the real-time communications industry forward. Ribbon isn't just about connecting point "a" to point "b." It is about encompassing the ability to ensure our contact points are elegantly and seamlessly simple to create, manage and automate. With the world more complexly woven together than ever before, the real-time communications we rely on must become automated and driven by AI operations. That is what Ribbon stands for.

Evidence You Can Rely On
Government and defense deployments demand proven, certified solutions. Ribbon backs key claims with DoD interoperability approvals, strong assurance signals, and large-scale deployments.

Ribbon supports defense missions with certified, interoperable communications and transport solutions. Ribbon products have achieved DISA JITC certification and are listed on the DISA/DoDIN Approved Products List (APL), including SBC and gateway platforms as well as PSX, RAMP, and Analytics. Ribbon was selected as the technology provider for DISA’s Soft Switch Backbone (SSBB) modernization program, our SBCs are FIPS compliant, JITC certified, and certified for Microsoft Teams, with Ribbon’s SBCs included in the Microsoft Teams DoDIN APL System Under Test. Ribbon is CMMC Certified with maximum number of points.
Secure Communications Solutions - FIPS Compliant and JITC Certified

Both civilian and military organizations deploy our Session Border Controllers (SBCs), Application Servers, and high-density Media Gateways as part of an end-to-end solution or as part of a Microsoft Teams migration.

Ribbon solutions use industry-standard SIP to simplify integration and migration, while protecting long-term investments. Ribbon Session Border Controllers are FIPS compliant, JITC certified, certified for Microsoft Teams and the only SBCs on the DODIN Approved Products list as part of the Microsoft Teams SUT. Ribbon’s Application Server is JITC certified for both LSC and ESC deployments and also the core of the largest VoIP deployment in the US Department of Defense.

Ribbon provides tailor-made, secure, hardened, field-proven defense solutions. These solutions integrate intelligent optical networking with agile IP/Packet connectivity to provide a converged, secure communication network.

Frequently Asked Defense Solutions Questions
What does “mission-critical defense network” mean in practice?

A mission-critical defense network is engineered for assured availability, secure interoperability, and resilient communications and transport across distributed environments. It supports real-time exchange of voice and data needed for command, coordination, and operations continuity.
How do primes reduce integration risk across coalition and multi-vendor environments?
Use standards-based SIP interconnect and policy control to integrate disparate systems while protecting long-term investments and enabling staged modernization rather than “rip and replace.”
Where do Session Border Controllers fit in a defense communications stack?

SBCs sit at trust boundaries and interconnect points to secure and control SIP-based real-time communications, supporting interoperability, policy enforcement, and protection of voice/UC services during migrations and steady-state operations.
How can you modernize analog/legacy endpoints without replacing everything?

High-density analog-to-SIP gateways and phased migration patterns can reduce barriers to VoIP modernization by converting legacy endpoints and preserving existing cabling/estates while moving to standards-based SIP.
Why pair IP/Packet with Optical layers?

IP/Packet provides agility for routing and service differentiation, while the Optical layer provides scalable secure capacity; together they support low-latency and high-bandwidth transport across long distances.
What is multilayer automation and why does it matter?

Multilayer automation reduces operational complexity across IP and optical layers by improving planning, analysis, and workflow automation, enabling faster and more reliable change execution at scale.

Evidence You Can Rely On
Government and defense deployments demand proven, certified solutions. Ribbon backs key claims with DoD interoperability approvals, strong assurance signals, and large-scale deployments.

Ribbon supports defense missions with certified, interoperable communications and transport solutions. Ribbon products have achieved DISA JITC certification and are listed on the DISA/DoDIN Approved Products List (APL), including SBC and gateway platforms as well as PSX, RAMP, and Analytics. Ribbon was selected as the technology provider for DISA’s Soft Switch Backbone (SSBB) modernization program, our SBCs are FIPS compliant, JITC certified, and certified for Microsoft Teams, with Ribbon’s SBCs included in the Microsoft Teams DoDIN APL System Under Test. Ribbon is CMMC Certified with maximum number of points.
Secure Communications Solutions - FIPS Compliant and JITC Certified

Both civilian and military organizations deploy our Session Border Controllers (SBCs), Application Servers, and high-density Media Gateways as part of an end-to-end solution or as part of a Microsoft Teams migration.

Ribbon solutions use industry-standard SIP to simplify integration and migration, while protecting long-term investments. Ribbon Session Border Controllers are FIPS compliant, JITC certified, certified for Microsoft Teams and the only SBCs on the DODIN Approved Products list as part of the Microsoft Teams SUT. Ribbon’s Application Server is JITC certified for both LSC and ESC deployments and also the core of the largest VoIP deployment in the US Department of Defense.

Resilient, Automated IP-Routing, Packet & Optical Transport Solutions

Decision-making on the modern battlefield requires real-time information to be made available when and where it is required. IP, Packet, and Optical networking provides both the agility to link the data generated from various sources to multiple destinations as well as the capacity required to transport bulk data over long distances with ultra-low latency.

Ribbon provides tailor-made, secure, hardened, field-proven defense solutions. These solutions integrate intelligent optical networking with agile IP/Packet connectivity to provide a converged, secure communication network.

Mission needs: High-capacity, low-latency, secure transport for sensor-to-decision-to-effect chains across distributed environments. A single automated communications network supporting video surveillance systems, command and control networks, sensors, radar, and smart IoT devices. Building blocks:

Ribbon Provides IP, Optical & Voice Security
Frequently Asked Defense Solutions Questions

A mission-critical defense network is engineered for assured availability, secure interoperability, and resilient communications and transport across distributed environments. It supports real-time exchange of voice and data needed for command, coordination, and operations continuity.
Use standards-based SIP interconnect and policy control to integrate disparate systems while protecting long-term investments and enabling staged modernization rather than “rip and replace.”

SBCs sit at trust boundaries and interconnect points to secure and control SIP-based real-time communications, supporting interoperability, policy enforcement, and protection of voice/UC services during migrations and steady-state operations.

High-density analog-to-SIP gateways and phased migration patterns can reduce barriers to VoIP modernization by converting legacy endpoints and preserving existing cabling/estates while moving to standards-based SIP.

IP/Packet provides agility for routing and service differentiation, while the Optical layer provides scalable secure capacity; together they support low-latency and high-bandwidth transport across long distances.

Multilayer automation reduces operational complexity across IP and optical layers by improving planning, analysis, and workflow automation, enabling faster and more reliable change execution at scale.
